descriptors.name: refdata.ForgeLink
descriptors.label: Forge Link
descriptors.description: A forge association on a legal entity — pointing at one of the deployment's configured forge connections in the context of this entity. An owned child record: it references the live forge configuration rather than copying it, so credentials and connection details stay in one place.
